KSyntaxHighlighting 6.22.0
https://invent.kde.org/frameworks/syntax-highlighting
Source: https://download.kde.org/stable/frameworks/6.22/syntax-highlighting-6.22.0.tar.xz
SHA256: 50b73ea99413dd988fa34fd169129bcdbfe1dc3b43c48d5f92bbadb2511a728a

The highlighting library is distributed under the MIT license. Syntax
and theme definitions have their own licenses and copyright notices, retained
in the embedded resources. Applicable license texts accompany this file.
ZzLogg links the library statically and embeds the definitions and themes.
No runtime download or KDE desktop installation is needed.

Build-time dependency: Extra CMake Modules 6.22.0 (BSD-3-Clause).
https://download.kde.org/stable/frameworks/6.22/extra-cmake-modules-6.22.0.tar.xz
SHA256: cb83a69571b277c20b3a6567ef0b6f39bf29c43a619282bf4bb076feb4c609a6
